div.div:
Why there is no stream here. The CDK comment is explicit: "No stream/TTL: profiles are lazily provisioned and never expire". The profile produces no integration event — no other context needs to react to a profile change.
Lazy provisioning (ADR-0017). The record is only created when the authenticated user first opens their own profile; the identity comes from the Cognito sub, never from the client.

text.tspan: Why there is no stream here. The CDK comment is explicit: "No stream/TTL: profiles are lazily provisioned and never expire". The profile produces
no integration event — no other context needs to react to a profile change.
Lazy provisioning (ADR-0017). The record is only created when the authenticated user first opens their own profile; the identity comes from the
Cognito sub, never from the client.
